cheapskates.line: But they're tightwads and they're cheapskates
stanza: Made a million during World War II
But they're tightwads and they're cheapskates
And they'll never give a dime to you
Even if I never get to see you again
I’ll know that when we collided
We both broke each other open
And I’m determined still to hold this open door
I wake up gasping in the void again

middleweights.line: He said, “I saw two men running out, they looked like middleweights
stanza: Alfred Bello had a partner and he had a rap for the cops
Him and Arthur Dexter Bradley were just out prowling around
He said, “I saw two men running out, they looked like middleweights
They jumped into a white car with out-of-state plates”
